At 5 months Theo is just about there -- Health Canada puts the window at around 6 months, and the readiness signs to watch for are sitting with support, losing the tongue-thrust reflex, and showing interest in food. Iron-rich foods like pureed meat or iron-fortified cereal are the right first choices when he's ready, confirmed with his provider at the 6-month visit.
